assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: continuous horizontal foreground street panorama PNG for the 2D game Présidentielles 2027, Banlieue B (Saint-Denis popular market), extending and correcting the attached original world-v2 artwork. Input image is the ORIGINAL panorama: preserve its warm detailed painted cartoon style, fine dark ink, stone textures, subdued golden daylight from left, charming irregular architecture. Rework ONLY the middle old-town market district into ONE coherent wide street scene, not individual sprite icons, not a contact sheet. Output very wide horizontal panorama, aspect ratio 3:1, target 1920x640 or higher proportional resolution, true transparent background above the roofs and behind the scene. No sky, no distant basilica, no distant skyline, no tall housing blocks: those will be a separate layer. Composition viewed straight from the pavement, slight depth into side streets matching original. Full canvas width is ONE sub-zone. At 22% of width: an old cream plaster house with two upper floors, slate mansard or simple tiled roof, permanent campaign office at street level, double entrance door centered precisely at 22% width. The door is about 8% of total image WIDTH in height; human-scaled door, upper floor heights around 7.3% width. Directly above that door is ONE blank cream rectangular sign, no lettering, with unobstructed edges. Beside this office to the left and right: varied small modest old Saint-Denis commercial houses, a bakery recognizable by a baguette pictogram, a produce store, no brands or text. IMPORTANT central 35%-65% width foreground is an open paved market square: continuous pavement and wide empty walking space for a meeting platform added by the game, absolutely no building, fence, hedge, raised stone stage or obstacle across this central foreground. A popular market with SIX LARGE fully visible stalls with red, green, blue and cream striped fabric awnings is in the back half of that square, fruits, vegetables, cheeses and crates fully visible, not covered by bushes. Their feet sit a little higher than the street doors to imply depth. There is an OPEN VIEW corridor through the center of the market towards the distant basilica that will be added separately. Right-hand commercial houses remain beyond 70% width. Architectural massing and market stalls must look integrated into a single painted neighborhood like the original, not aligned stickers. Roofline varied. At both outer edges use narrow low trees, foliage, murets and receding streets that naturally finish the silhouettes, no facade cut vertically at image boundary. All door thresholds and nearest pavement share the same straight horizontal reference near 90% image height. Only a shallow pavement footing, transparent below its lower edge so the game can draw the road. No parked vehicles, no people, no text anywhere, no flags or labels except small French flag at the campaign office optional. Do not fill empty plaza with decorative flowers; no continuous hedge or iron fence, no duplicate identical buildings. Keep the original scene's painted precision and warm natural restrained vegetation. Do not imitate the recent expanded atlases.
assets.correction: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redraw this doorway and its street-level shopfront so the entrance is 180px HIGH, from about y=414 to594, threshold still y594. Its center must be x≈478 (22% canvas width). Above the blank cream sign, keep ONE ordinary upper floor plus a modest mansard attic, adjusting the upper architecture so roof and chimneys remain inside the canvas. No extra blue interactive-looking storefronts: replace the left blue storefront with an ordinary old-town shop with a small vegetable pictogram and visible produce window, and replace the rightmost blue institutional storefront with an ordinary warm bakery/food shop identifiable from its display, no blank institutional sign. Keep the large six-stall feeling (the current four large stalls may stay, add small adjacent stands only if natural), with striped cloth awnings. Central corridor stays open upwards to the distant basilica added separately. No hedge, fence, raised stage, people, vehicles, words or logos. assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: single continuous distant old-town background layer for Banlieue B, Saint-Denis market, in Présidentielles 2027. Central axis opens through old roofs and trees toward the Gothic west facade, so the rose window and church front are actually visible, not buried behind a continuous row of buildings. Low houses recede in perspective toward the basilica like the ORIGINAL. Lighter less contrasted slightly bluish distant tones, but retain original painted detail and style, no blurred photographic smear. Tree groves on the sides of the town extend naturally to both edges, with soft irregular SILHOUETTE contours tapering toward the baseline; no buildings or hills clipped vertically at canvas edges. Transparent bottom beyond the shallow foliage baseline, no opaque rectangular patch or sky rectangle. No tall blocks or modern apartment towers anywhere in this B scene. No market stalls, no foreground interactive buildings, no signs, no text, no vehicles or people. This image will sit behind the foreground market, with a stable slow parallax.
